title: Parametric EQ Design
text: Design tunable parametric equalizer coefficients, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough; {Smooth tuned filter parameters} sets the smooth filter parameters when tuning, {Smoothing factor}, {Maximum filter order}, {Specify filter order from input port} uses additional input port to specify filter, {Filter order}, {Specify gain from input port} uses additional input port to specify gain, {Gain (dB)}, {Specify normalized center frequency from input port} uses additional input port to specify normalized center, {Normalized center frequency}, {Specify normalized bandwidth from input port} uses additional input port to specify normalized, {Normalized bandwidth}, {Filter cascade sections form} sets the form of cascaded filter sections Second-order, {Output data type} sets the data type of output, {Sample time} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Fc
ports.summary: Normalized center frequency scalar in range [0,1]

params.name: Smooth tuned filter parameters
params.values: Smooth filter parameters when tuning off (default) | on

params.name: Maximum filter order
params.values: Maximum filter order 2 (default) | positive even integer

params.values: Use additional input port to specify filter order off (default) | on

params.values: Use additional input port to specify normalized center frequency off (default) | on
